intent: One identity entry, phone-first and WhatsApp-native, used both as the reusable guest-gate sheet and as the plain sign-in. It never loses a draft: after authentication the exact screen, selections and scroll are restored (ADR 0007 D9). Password, biometric unlock and password recovery are tertiary paths.

screens.purpose: The single identity entry (no separate Sign up and Login) and the reusable guest-gate sheet. A context line says why the account is needed; after auth the interrupted intent resumes exactly.
interactions: Compound phone field: fixed non-interactive +965 chip plus eight digits, numeric keypad, LTR in both languages, loose shape check; primary gold button 'Continue with WhatsApp' / «المتابعة عبر واتساب» sends the code
Secondary buttons: 'Continue with Apple' (iOS only) and 'Continue with Google'; tertiary text link 'Use a password' / «استخدام كلمة المرور»

Context line variants by trigger: to send your request, to pay, to send a message, to write a review, to request a consultation, to request a quote, to see your rewards, to keep your shortlist on every device
On success the sheet closes and resumes the stored guest intent (route, step, selections, scroll position); a verified phone is mandatory before the first request, payment or message
Sign-up nudge: appears once after the third heart, with the context 'Keep your shortlist on every device' / «حفظ المفضلة على كل أجهزتكم»; Not now dismisses it for good
Voucher-era context lines for the gate: "to get your voucher", "to send your request", "to book a visit"; after sign-in the exact quote, scroll and selected package are restored (ADR 0007 D8)
A quiet footer line "Hotel or service provider? Use the Ghazal Partner app" explains that this sheet creates a Client account only (CA-AUTH-12); there is no account-type chooser in the client app
screens.contentNotes: Title «تسجيل الدخول أو المتابعة» / 'Sign in or continue'. Small print under the buttons links Terms and Privacy (acceptance happens at account creation in CL-AUTH-03). Phone display uses the formatter: +965 5000 0012 inside an LTR isolate, never a tappable tel: link in the prototype. Error copy is calm and blameless: «تحققوا من الرقم: يجب أن يتكون من 8 أرقام» / 'Check the number: it needs 8 digits'; not on WhatsApp: 'We could not send a code to this number on WhatsApp' with Apple, Google and Support offered (there is no SMS fallback, ADR 0028). Apple private-relay email handled silently. If the signed-in identity already holds a different Brief, the Brief merge sheet (CL-DISC-02, merge variant) appears after resume. Guests keep hearts, Compare set and the Brief on the device until merge (ADR 0007 D10).

screens.purpose: Verify the phone with a six-digit code delivered over WhatsApp. Also reused inline in the booking Details step and for password reset and phone change.
interactions: Six boxes in LTR order in both languages (digit 1 at the left), paste and one-time-code autofill, Eastern digits normalised on paste
Resend after a 60-second countdown; 'Open WhatsApp' link; 'Change number' returns to the sheet
Five attempts, then a temporary lock state; code lives 5 minutes
Delivery-failed state offers resend, Apple, Google and Support (no SMS fallback)
Success draws the check once (success haptic) and continues: new account to name and terms, existing account straight to the resumed intent
screens.contentNotes: Heading is a noun phrase, not an imperative: «رمز التحقق المرسل إلى +965 5000 0012» / 'Code sent to +965 5000 0012' with the number in an LTR isolate. Wrong code, passive and calm: «الرمز غير صحيح، يمكنكم المحاولة مرة أخرى» / 'That code is not right. You can try again'. Expired: 'This code has expired. A new one is on its way when you tap Resend'. Locked: 'Too many attempts. Please try again later or contact Support'. In the booking flow the same component appears as a sheet titled 'Verify your number to send the request' without leaving the step. Store-review demo account is a production flag, never visible in the UI.

screens.purpose: Final step for a brand-new account: confirm the name and accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Onboarding answers held on the device attach to the account here.
interactions: Full name field (dir=auto, prefilled from onboarding when present) and optional email field (LTR, email keyboard)
Checkbox 'I accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy' with two links that open the legal pages in-app; required before Create account
Primary 'Continue' / «متابعة» creates the account, attaches the local Brief, hearts and Compare set, then resumes the intent
Live monogram preview in the first letter of the name
screens.contentNotes: Legal texts are supplied by the owner and served from the Super Admin CMS; placeholder headings only in the prototype. Name example «ريم الدوسري», email optional 'reem@example.com'. Acceptance is logged once per account. The Arabic checkbox label is a statement of acceptance, not an imperative: «أوافق على شروط الاستخدام وسياسة الخصوصية». Tab bar hidden. Voucher model (ADR 0033): the terms link now lists the platform terms and the voucher terms in one reader; the voucher terms say in plain words that the KD 2 is paid to Ghazal, that the event price is paid to the venue directly, and when a voucher is reusable, forfeited or eligible for a credit voucher from support.

ownerRound1.change: Terms line: lapse forfeits, support credit instead of refund
ownerRound1.note: Voucher line in the terms: "The KD 2 is paid to Ghazal. If you do not confirm in 24 hours the voucher is no longer valid. Refunds are credit vouchers from support, never money."

screens.purpose: Tertiary path for people who prefer a password: sign in, create a password account, and recover a forgotten password, as modes of one screen.
interactions: Sign in: identifier (Kuwait mobile with the fixed +965 chip; no email sign-in) and password with show/hide; 'Forgot password?' link
Create account: verified mobile number first through the WhatsApp code, then a new password with live strength and rules; the account is created once the number is verified
Forgot password: request a WhatsApp code to the verified number (email link only where a verified email exists), enter the code, then set a new password
Mode switch link at the bottom: 'New here? Create an account' / «حساب جديد» and 'Back to WhatsApp sign-in'
screens.contentNotes: Identifier rule: The Kuwait mobile number behind the fixed non-interactive +965 chip is the only identifier, as in CL-AUTH-01; no other country codes in the MVP (a foreign number signs in with Apple or Google, OQ-L-14); email is optional and never an identifier (ADR 0012 D1, ADR 0028). Passwords are never shown in analytics or logs. Error copy is blameless: «بيانات الدخول غير صحيحة» / 'Those details do not match an account'. Locked state names the wait, not the cause. Reset success returns to sign-in with the identifier prefilled.

screens.purpose: Optional app lock: a pre-prompt sheet after the first sign-in and the unlock screen shown on launch to returning users. Biometrics unlock a stored session; they never replace first login.
interactions: Pre-prompt sheet: 'Unlock Ghazal with Face ID' (wording follows the platform: Face ID, Touch ID or fingerprint) with Turn on and Not now
Unlock screen: monogram, name and a single 'Unlock' button; the system prompt opens automatically once
After a failed attempt the fallback is the WhatsApp code or password; three failures never lock the account, only the shortcut
The same toggle lives in Settings (CL-PROF-05)
screens.contentNotes: Unlock screen shows monogram «ر», 'Reem Al-Dosari' and the quiet line 'Unlock to continue' / «الفتح للمتابعة». Never a security-theatre lock icon larger than the monogram. Face ID usage description is localised in Info.plist strings. Unavailable state (no biometrics enrolled) hides the pre-prompt entirely and shows a disabled Settings row with the reason.
